title: Singular Sound BeatBuddy

controlChangeCommands.name: Bank MSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Song folder select MSB

controlChangeCommands.name: Bank LSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Song folder select LSB

controlChangeCommands.name: Tempo Inc
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Increases tempo by the received value

controlChangeCommands.name: Tempo Dec
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Decreases tempo by the received value

controlChangeCommands.name: Half Time
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Returns to normal time at 0; values 1-127 enter half-time mode at the next measure

controlChangeCommands.name: Double Time
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Returns to normal time at 0; values 1-127 enter double-time mode at the next measure

controlChangeCommands.name: Data Inc
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Data Entry +1; increments BeatBuddy tempo by default

controlChangeCommands.name: Data Dec
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Data Entry -1; decrements BeatBuddy tempo by default

controlChangeCommands.name: Tempo MSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Used with Tempo LSB to set a specific tempo; MSB 1 multiplies BPM by 129 or greater

controlChangeCommands.name: Tempo LSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Used with Tempo MSB to set a specific tempo; BeatBuddy updates tempo when LSB is received

controlChangeCommands.name: Accent Hit
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Triggers current song part accent hit; value controls accent volume

controlChangeCommands.name: Pause/Unpause
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 unpauses, 1 pauses, values > 1 toggle pause/unpause

controlChangeCommands.name: Transition
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Values 1-32 start transition to part number; 0 completes transition at next measure; 125 cancels; 126 previous part; 127 next part

controlChangeCommands.name: Intro/Start
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Starts playback or triggers the intro

controlChangeCommands.name: Outro/Stop
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Triggers the outro of the song

controlChangeCommands.name: Drum Set
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Value 1 selects the first drum set

controlChangeCommands.name: Tap Tempo
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Enters Tap Tempo mode and generates a tap event

controlChangeCommands.name: Enter/Exit
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Enters or exits a folder

controlChangeCommands.name: Scroll
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Scrolls the song/folder list

controlChangeCommands.name: Main Pedal
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 emulates main pedal release; values 1-127 emulate main pedal press

controlChangeCommands.name: Excl Trans
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Exclusive transition; values 1-32 start transition to part number; 0 completes transition at next measure; 126 previous part; 127 next part

controlChangeCommands.name: No Fill Trans
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: No-fill transition; values 1-32 start transition to part number; 0 completes transition at next measure; 126 previous part; 127 next part

x_pc.additionalInfo: Default song select uses Bank Select MSB CC0, LSB CC32, and PC. MSB selects the bank, LSB selects the folder within the bank, and PC selects the song within the current folder. If only PC is sent, it opens the corresponding song in the current folder.

additionalInfo: BeatBuddy can send MIDI clock, start, stop, optional MIDI notes, and song select messages. MIDI OUT can be configured as MIDI OUT, MERGE, THRU, or disabled. Outbound CC102 can force Aeros transition/next part, and outbound CC103 can send time signature values.
